gen-dafont-ethnocentric-fs-alpino: Alpino reads tall and friendly, its short-looking ascenders and tight spacing giving text a casual, lived-in feel. Ethnocentric barrels in above it, wide-tracked and fast, and that jolt of speed is the best thing about the pair.
gen-dafont-ethnocentric-fs-hind: Hind reads steadily, its lowercase nearly as tall as its capitals and every stroke drawn taut. Ethnocentric does its best work big and short, where its stretched, aggressive letters can spread out.
gen-dafont-ethnocentric-fs-nunito: Short ascenders sit over huge bowls in Ethnocentric, and its letters are pushed wide apart for speed. Nunito's soft round lowercase calms it down.
gen-dafont-ethnocentric-fs-pilcrow-round: Aggressive and fast, Ethnocentric stretches its letters wide over big bowls and short ascenders. Pilcrow Rounded would settle into a long read warmly, its tall lowercase and generous counters keeping the lines comfortable.
gen-dafont-ethnocentric-fs-quicksand: Ethnocentric's wide-tracked letters, short ascenders and big bowls give it a fast, forceful stride on its own. Quicksand's glassy round lowercase is the sharpest foil.
gen-dafont-existence-fs-nunito: Industrial, but with a friendly neighbor. Existence sets wide porthole counters and uniform, tube-like strokes up top, while Nunito follows beneath with big round bowls and open, softly finished terminals that loosen the whole page.
gen-dafont-existence-fs-quicksand: Quicksand brings tall, bulb-round lowercase and uniform bar thickness, a gentle voice for the page. Existence stays industrial above it, and its sturdy, even-massed letters are the strongest quality here, giving the soft sans something to lean against.
gen-dafont-galaxy-fs-alpino: Alpino is tall and cozy, with short-looking ascenders and tight spacing that keep text casual. Galaxy earns its keep big and short, where its loose, commanding letters can drift.
gen-dafont-galaxy-fs-hind: Commanding, Galaxy lays down dense tall lowercase and loose letterfit with lines of uniform width throughout. Hind follows in a long read with steady strokes and open-ended c shapes, keeping text easy and unfussy.
gen-dafont-galaxy-fs-nunito: Galaxy is cosmic, dense and loosely spaced, with round letters as heavy as straight ones. Nunito's soft, big-bowled lowercase makes the sharpest counterweight beneath it, and that difference in temperament is what holds the pair together.
